description: The line plot illustrates the WikiText validation perplexity of three large language models—LLaMA1-7B, LLaMA1-13B, and Vicuna-7B—after being pruned to 70% sparsity using the OWL method, with perplexity measured across different values of the pruning parameter M ranging from 3 to 8. The x-axis, labeled “M,” is linearly scaled from 3 to 8 with integer tick marks at each unit. The y-axis, labeled “Perplexity,” is linearly scaled from approximately 15 to 45, with major tick marks at intervals of 10. Three distinct lines represent the models: LLaMA1-7B (green circles connected by solid lines) starts at a perplexity of ~28 at M=3, dips slightly to ~25 at M=5, then rises to ~36 at M=8; LLaMA1-13B (orange stars connected by solid lines) begins at ~20 at M=3, declines to ~17 at M=5, and gradually increases to ~20 at M=8; Vicuna-7B (blue triangles connected by solid lines) starts at ~41 at M=3, decreases to ~34 at M=5, remains relatively flat until M=7, then rises to ~40 at M=8. All lines show non-monotonic behavior, with local minima around M=5 or M=6, and generally increasing perplexity toward higher M values.
